claims.text: Vision: visual acuity screen at 4 and 5 years; instrument-based screening may be used at 3 through 5 years.
claims.quote: 7. A visual acuity screen is recommended at ages 4 and 5 years, as well as in cooperative 3-year-olds. Instrument-based screening may be used to assess risk at ages 12 and 24 months, in addition to the well visits at 3 through 5 years of age.

claims.text: Tuberculosis: test on recognition of high-risk factors, per the AAP Red Book.
claims.quote: Tuberculosis testing per recommendations of the AAP Committee on Infectious Diseases, published in the current edition of the AAP Red Book: Report of the Committee on Infectious Diseases. Testing should be performed on recognition of high-risk factors.

claims.text: Oral health: check for a dental home; if none, do a risk assessment and refer to one; recommend brushing with fluoride toothpaste in the proper dosage for age.
claims.quote: Assess whether the child has a dental home. If no dental home is identified, perform a risk assessment (https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/oral-health/oral-healthpractice-tools/) and refer to a dental home. Recommend brushing with fluoride toothpaste in the proper dosage for age.

claims.text: Fluoride varnish: apply to primary teeth starting at tooth eruption (USPSTF); once teeth are present, every 3 to 6 months in the primary care or dental office based on caries risk.
claims.quote: The USPSTF recommends that primary care clinicians apply fluoride varnish to the primary teeth of all infants and children starting at the age of primary tooth eruption (https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/preventionof-dental-caries-in-children-younger-than-age-5-years-screening-and-interventions1). Once teeth are present, apply fluoride varnish to all children every 3 to 6 months in the primary care or dental office based on caries risk.

claims.text: Fluoride supplementation: consider it if the primary water source is deficient in fluoride.
claims.quote: If primary water source is deficient in fluoride, consider oral fluoride supplementation.

claims.text: Immunizations: every visit is an opportunity to update and complete them.
claims.quote: Every visit should be an opportunity to update and complete a child’s immunizations.
